title: A Tiny Nail Can Still Be Outside the Repair Zone
topic: Puncture repairability depends on location and size, not only how small the nail looks
mechanicTruth: Industry puncture-repair guidance limits repairs to the designated tread repair area and size limits; injuries extending into the shoulder or belt-edge area are not normal repair candidates.

voiceoverScript: A puncture can be tiny and still be in the wrong place for a normal repair. Industry guidance limits repairs to the proper tread area and size. Location, internal condition, tire type, and manufacturer restrictions all matter.
selectedCaption: Small nail does not automatically mean small repair. Location and internal condition matter. Nick's can dismount and inspect the tire before deciding whether repair is appropriate.
avoidedForRepetition: Distinct from plug-vs-patch: this is the physical repair-zone boundary, not repair method.
